title: 横顔から、目が合う
summary: 前髪と目元を見せる、静かな表情のリール。
steps: 横顔を近めで撮る
ゆっくりカメラを見る
少し微笑んで2秒キープ

reference.creator: 佐藤ノア
reference.referencePoint: 髪を整えた日の、斜め向きの顔・前髪・カメラ目線の見せ方。胸上の近い画角を参考にする。
reference.originalAddition: 横顔から正面へ向く順番と、最後の微笑みはなおい用に追加する。
reference.referencePointEn: How an angled face, bangs, and camera-facing gaze are shown after a hair appointment. Use the close, chest-up framing as a reference.
reference.originalAdditionEn: For Naoi, add the sequence of turning from profile to front and finishing with a slight smile.

en.title: From profile to eye contact
en.summary: A quiet expression reel that highlights Naoi's bangs and eyes.
steps: Film a close profile view
Have her slowly look at the camera
Hold a slight smile for 2 seconds

title: 静止画だと思ったら
summary: 止まった姿から小さく動き出す、ポートレート風の一本。
steps: 写真のように2秒止まる
まばたきして髪に触れる
最後は自然な表情で止まる

reference.creator: 高嶺ヒナ
reference.referencePoint: 白い背景で顔を大きく見せる、ポートレート中心の映像。目元と前髪が目立つ正面寄りの画角。
reference.originalAddition: 冒頭で2秒止まり、その後まばたき・髪を触る構成はなおい用の演出。
reference.referencePointEn: Portrait-focused footage with a large face against a white background. The near-frontal framing highlights the eyes and bangs.
reference.originalAdditionEn: For Naoi, begin with a 2-second still pose, then add a blink and a touch of the hair.

en.title: A still portrait comes to life
en.summary: A portrait-style clip that begins motionless, then adds a small movement.
steps: Stay still like a photograph for 2 seconds
Blink and touch the hair
Finish with a relaxed expression

title: 今日の私服、一気見
summary: 完成したコーデを最初に見せ、顔と細部へつなぐ。
steps: 靴まで入る全身を撮る
顔・袖・バッグなどを寄りで撮る
全身→寄り→全身の順で編集

reference.creator: なえなの
reference.referencePoint: 5枚目のバッグを肩に掛けた全身横姿で、服のシルエットと小物が同時に分かる構図。補助リールは私服・顔・日常の組み合わせを参照。
reference.originalAddition: 全身→顔→細部→全身のカット順はなおい用の構成。
reference.referencePointEn: Slide 5: a full-length side view with a bag on the shoulder, showing the clothing silhouette and accessories together. The secondary reel offers an example of combining an everyday outfit, face, and daily-life moments.
reference.originalAdditionEn: For Naoi, arrange the cuts as full length, face, details, then full length again.

en.title: Today's outfit at a glance
en.summary: Show the finished outfit first, then move to the face and details.
steps: Film a full-length view including the shoes
Capture close-ups of the face, sleeves, and bag
Edit in the order: full length, details, full length

title: 3歩だけのランウェイ
summary: 短い距離を歩き、私服のシルエットと動きを見せる。
steps: 少し離れた位置から3歩歩く
止まって目線を外す
正面と斜めの2方向で撮る

reference.creator: 佐藤ノア
reference.referencePoint: 外出先での私服と、近い距離から撮る自然な表情。服を着てその場にいる日常の空気感を参考にする。
reference.originalAddition: 3歩歩く→止まる→目線を外す動きはなおい用に設計する。参考動画と同じ動作の完全再現ではない。
reference.referencePointEn: An everyday outfit on an outing, with natural expressions filmed at close range. Refer to the relaxed feeling of being in a real place in her own clothes.
reference.originalAdditionEn: For Naoi, design a three-step walk, a stop, and an off-camera glance. These movements are added for this shoot rather than copied from the reference.

en.title: A three-step runway
en.summary: A short walk shows the outfit's silhouette and movement.
steps: Walk three steps from a short distance away
Stop and look away from the camera
Film from the front and at an angle

title: 好きな部分だけ5連発
summary: 顔・服・小物の好きなところを短いカットで並べる。
steps: 前髪・アクセ・袖・バッグ・顔を撮る
各カットを2秒ずつ長めに残す
5カットをテンポよくつなぐ

reference.creator: 佐藤ノア
reference.referencePoint: 白いバッグ・服・ネックレス・ぬいぐるみを近距離で見せる細部の画角。『持っている物』から好みを伝える。
reference.originalAddition: 前髪・アクセ・袖・バッグ・顔の5カットに置き換える。
reference.referencePointEn: Close framing of a white bag, clothing, a necklace, and a plush toy. Use personal belongings to communicate taste.
reference.originalAdditionEn: Replace the details with five shots of Naoi's bangs, jewelry, sleeves, bag, and face.

en.title: Five favorite details
en.summary: A quick sequence of favorite details from the face, outfit, and accessories.
steps: Capture bangs, jewelry, sleeves, bag, and face
Record at least 2 seconds of each detail
Join the five shots with a clear rhythm

title: 羽織るだけで変わる
summary: ジャケットやカーディガンを羽織る動きを見せる。
steps: 羽織りを手に持った姿から撮る
その場で羽織り、襟か袖を整える
完成した姿でポーズを取る

reference.creator: なえなの
reference.referencePoint: 3枚目は肩にチェックシャツを結ぶ着方、4枚目はジャージの肩掛け。羽織りの扱い方を参考にする。
reference.originalAddition: 着用前→羽織る→襟や袖を整える動作をつないだリールにする。
reference.referencePointEn: Slide 3 shows a checked shirt tied around the shoulders; slide 4 shows a track jacket draped over the shoulders. Refer to how the outer layers are styled.
reference.originalAdditionEn: Create a reel linking the look before the layer is worn, putting it on, and adjusting the collar or sleeves.

en.title: One layer changes the look
en.summary: Show the movement of putting on a jacket or cardigan.
steps: Start with the outer layer in hand
Put it on and adjust the collar or sleeves
Finish with a pose in the complete look

title: 黒コーデと明るいコーデ
summary: 同じ構図の2着を切り替え、印象の違いを見せる。
steps: カメラ位置と立ち位置を固定
2着で同じポーズを撮る
全身と顔の寄りを交互につなぐ

reference.creator: 高嶺ヒナ
reference.referencePoint: 白・グレー系と黒系の2人が、同じ明るい背景で並ぶ。配色差と服の形が分かる正面の見せ方。
reference.originalAddition: 元は2人の投稿。なおい1人で同じ位置・ポーズを2着撮影し、交互につなぐ。
reference.referencePointEn: Two people in white/gray and black stand together against the same bright background. Refer to the front-facing view that makes the colors and clothing shapes easy to compare.
reference.originalAdditionEn: The original features two people. Film Naoi alone in two outfits, using the same position and poses, then alternate the shots.

en.title: Dark look, light look
en.summary: Switch between two outfits in the same composition to show their different moods.
steps: Keep the camera and standing position fixed
Film the same poses in both outfits
Alternate full-length shots and face close-ups

title: 同じ服で3つの着方
summary: 手持ちの羽織りや小物で着こなしを変える。
steps: 羽織りを着る姿を撮る
肩に掛ける・手に持つ姿を撮る
同じ位置の3カットで比較

reference.creator: なえなの
reference.referencePoint: 2枚目の裾を持つ手、3枚目のシャツの肩結び、4枚目の肩掛け、5枚目のバッグを持った全身。服と小物の扱いを参考にする。
reference.originalAddition: 元投稿は同じ1着の3通りではない。なおいの手持ちの羽織りを『着る・肩掛け・手持ち』へ展開する。
reference.referencePointEn: Slides 2–5: hands holding a hem, a shirt tied around the shoulders, a draped outer layer, and a full-length view with a bag. Refer to how the clothing and accessories are handled.
reference.originalAdditionEn: The original does not show one outfit styled three ways. Use Naoi's own outer layer worn normally, draped over the shoulders, and held in hand.

en.title: One outfit, three ways
en.summary: Restyle the look using an outer layer or accessories already on hand.
steps: Film the outer layer worn normally
Film it draped over the shoulders and held in hand
Compare three shots from the same position

title: 鏡の中から目が合う
summary: 鏡越しに、服を整える自然な動きと目線を撮る。
steps: 鏡に全身か上半身を入れる
服を整えてスマホから目を離す
鏡の中のカメラを見る

reference.creator: なえなの
reference.referencePoint: 1枚目の鏡越しの顔寄り、4枚目の鏡越しの腰上。顔とスマホ・カメラの距離感を参考にする。
reference.originalAddition: 服を整える→スマホから目を離す→鏡の中で目線を合わせる動きを追加する。
reference.referencePointEn: Slide 1: a close mirror portrait. Slide 4: a waist-up mirror view. Refer to the distance between the face, phone, and camera.
reference.originalAdditionEn: Add the movements of adjusting the outfit, looking away from the phone, and making eye contact through the mirror.

en.title: Eye contact in the mirror
en.summary: Capture a natural outfit adjustment and a glance through the mirror.
steps: Frame the full body or upper body in the mirror
Adjust the outfit and look away from the phone
Look at the camera through the mirror

title: 座ったときもかわいい服
summary: 座る・立つ動きで、服の形や落ち方を見せる。
steps: 椅子に座った全身を撮る
袖や手元を寄りで撮る
立ち上がった全身で終える

reference.creator: ゆら
reference.referencePoint: 黒い服でソファに座り、靴まで全身を入れた構図。座ったときの服の落ち方と手足の配置を参考にする。
reference.originalAddition: 座り全身→手元→立ち上がった全身の3カットへ展開する。
reference.referencePointEn: Slide 1: a seated sofa portrait in black, framed from face to shoes. Refer to the clothing drape and placement of the hands and feet.
reference.originalAdditionEn: Develop it into three shots: seated full length, hands, then standing full length.

en.title: The outfit looks good seated, too
en.summary: Use sitting and standing to show the outfit's shape and drape.
steps: Film a full-length seated view
Capture close-ups of sleeves and hands
End with a full-length standing view

title: バッグの中の「好き」3つ
summary: 本人が見せたい小物で、趣味や好みを伝える。
steps: バッグから小物を3つ出す
それぞれを手元の寄りで撮る
一番好きな物を顔の横に持つ

reference.creator: 佐藤ノア
reference.referencePoint: 本人が長く続けているシール帳の趣味を、手元の寄りで見せる。持ち物から人物像を伝える発想。
reference.originalAddition: 元はバッグ紹介ではない。なおいが見せたい小物3つをバッグから出す演出へ置き換える。
reference.referencePointEn: A long-standing sticker-album hobby is shown through close-ups of the hands. Refer to the idea of revealing personality through personal belongings.
reference.originalAdditionEn: The original is not a bag tour. Have Naoi take three items she wants to share out of her bag.

en.title: Three favorites from the bag
en.summary: Let the small items Naoi chooses to share reveal her interests and taste.
steps: Take three items out of the bag
Film each item in a close-up of the hands
Hold the favorite item beside the face

title: 決め顔の、その直後
summary: きれいな決め顔と、自然に笑う瞬間を一本にする。
steps: 決めた表情を2秒撮る
撮影を止めず会話を続ける
自然に笑った瞬間につなぐ

reference.creator: なえなの
reference.referencePoint: 屋外の自然光で、カップを持ちながら近い距離で見せる柔らかな表情。自然な笑顔の近さを参考にする。
reference.originalAddition: 決め顔→撮影後の笑いという対比はなおい用の構成。海や帽子を再現する必要はない。
reference.referencePointEn: Soft expressions filmed at close range outdoors in natural light while holding a cup. Refer to the camera distance and approachable smile.
reference.originalAdditionEn: The contrast between a posed expression and laughter after the shot is an added structure for Naoi. The beach and hat are not required.

en.title: Right after the perfect pose
en.summary: Pair a polished expression with a moment of genuine laughter.
steps: Record the posed expression for 2 seconds
Keep filming while the conversation continues
Cut to the moment she naturally laughs

title: 撮影を待っているなおい
summary: 待機中の仕草から撮影モードへ変わる瞬間。
steps: 待っている自然な姿を撮る
合図で姿勢と目線を切り替える
撮影前後に2秒ずつ余白を残す

reference.creator: 高嶺ヒナ（gai_hasunumaとの共同投稿）
reference.referencePoint: ヘアセット中に鏡の前で待つ表情・頬に添えた手・前髪の準備を、胸上で撮る場面。
reference.originalAddition: 待機中→撮影開始に気付く→姿勢が変わる構成はなおい用に追加。
reference.referencePointEn: A chest-up view of waiting in front of a mirror during hairstyling, including the expression, a hand near the cheek, and bang preparation.
reference.originalAdditionEn: For Naoi, add the sequence of waiting, noticing that filming has started, and changing her posture.

en.title: Naoi between takes
en.summary: Catch the shift from waiting naturally to being ready for the camera.
steps: Film her natural movements while waiting
Use a cue to change posture and gaze
Leave 2 seconds before and after the action

title: 無言で答えるファッション二択
summary: 服や小物を選ぶ姿から本人の好みを見せる。
steps: 服か小物を左右に提示
本人が好きな方を選ぶ
選んだ物を身に着けた姿で終える

reference.creator: 佐藤ノア
reference.referencePoint: お気に入りの物を手に取って見せ、本人の好みが伝わる見せ方。本文にも迷って選んだ物の説明がある。
reference.originalAddition: 元はぬいぐるみの買い物紹介。服・小物の左右二択と指差しの流れはなおい用に追加する。
reference.referencePointEn: Holding up favorite objects to communicate personal taste. The caption also describes items chosen after some deliberation.
reference.originalAdditionEn: The original introduces purchased plush toys. Add left/right clothing or accessory choices and pointing gestures for Naoi.

en.title: This or that: outfit edition
en.summary: Show personal taste through a silent choice of clothes or accessories.
steps: Present one option on each side
Have her choose the one she likes
Finish with the chosen item being worn

title: 好きな曲を聴いている顔
summary: 音楽を楽しむ小さな動きや表情を残す。
steps: 最初は静かな表情を撮る
本人が自然にリズムに乗る
楽しそうな表情まで長めに回す

reference.creator: 佐藤ノア
reference.referencePoint: ヘッドホン姿と横顔を近くから写し、本人と音楽との関係を伝える場面。
reference.originalAddition: 元は自作曲の仮歌収録。なおいは歌唱の再現をせず、好きな曲を聴く表情と小さなリズムの動きへ置き換える。
reference.referencePointEn: Close views of a side profile wearing headphones, showing the person's connection with music.
reference.originalAdditionEn: The original shows guide-vocal recording for an original song. For Naoi, use listening expressions and small rhythmic movements rather than recreating the singing.

en.title: When her favorite song plays
en.summary: Capture the small movements and expressions of enjoying music.
steps: Begin with a quiet expression
Let her naturally move with the rhythm
Keep filming until a happy expression appears

title: 撮影準備を10秒に
summary: 髪・アクセ・服を整える準備から完成まで。
steps: 髪・アクセ・袖を整える姿を撮る
手元の寄りと上半身を残す
完成した姿のカットで締める

reference.creator: 佐藤ノア
reference.referencePoint: 室内で髪をまとめる手や顔を近距離で写す、ケア・準備の画角。
reference.originalAddition: 髪→アクセ→袖→完成姿の4カットに整理し、10〜15秒へまとめる。
reference.referencePointEn: Close indoor framing of the face and hands gathering the hair. Refer to the camera distance used for a care or preparation moment.
reference.originalAdditionEn: Arrange four shots—hair, accessories, sleeves, finished look—into a 10–15-second sequence.

en.title: Shoot prep in ten seconds
en.summary: Follow hair, accessories, and outfit adjustments through to the finished look.
steps: Film hair, jewelry, and sleeve adjustments
Capture hands close-up and upper-body shots
Finish on the completed look

title: 撮られている姿と完成写真
summary: 撮影の裏側と、その瞬間の仕上がりをつなぐ。
steps: 横から撮影風景を動画で撮る
同じ瞬間に写真も撮る
撮影風景→完成写真→オフの表情

reference.creator: 佐藤ノア（noranosatonoahとの共同投稿）
reference.referencePoint: 撮影日のsetlog。衣装ラックや撮影セットを含む、完成前の現場を見せる構成。
reference.originalAddition: 横から撮ったBTS→その瞬間の完成写真→撮影後の表情、という順番はなおい用に組む。
reference.referencePointEn: A shoot-day setlog showing the setting before the finished images, including clothing racks and the shoot setup.
reference.originalAdditionEn: For Naoi, edit side-view behind-the-scenes footage, the photo made in that moment, then her relaxed expression afterward.

en.title: Behind the shot and the final photo
en.summary: Connect the shooting process with the photograph made in that moment.
steps: Film the photo session from the side
Take a still photo at the same moment
Edit: behind the scenes, final photo, relaxed expression

title: 私服のまま、ステージの目線
summary: 普段の表情と、ライブを意識した強い目線を見せる。
steps: 普段の柔らかい表情から撮る
ライブを意識した立ち姿と目線へ
最後は普段の表情に戻る

reference.creator: 鈴木Mob.
reference.referencePoint: ソロ生誕祭の記録で、アイドルとしての完成した衣装姿と正面の表情を見せる。『ステージ側の自分』の参考。
reference.originalAddition: 衣装やライブを再現せず、私服の柔らかい表情→ステージを意識した目線→普段の表情へ切り替える。
reference.referencePointEn: A solo birthday-event record showing a finished idol outfit and a front-facing expression. Refer to the presentation of her on-stage identity.
reference.originalAdditionEn: Keep Naoi in everyday clothes and move from a soft expression to a stage-inspired gaze, then back to her everyday expression. The costume and live event are not recreated.

en.title: Stage presence in everyday clothes
en.summary: Show both her everyday expression and the strong gaze she brings to a performance.
steps: Start with a soft, everyday expression
Shift to a stage-inspired posture and gaze
Return to her everyday expression at the end

title: 会ったときのなおいちゃん
summary: カメラに気付き、挨拶するような距離感の一本。
steps: 少し離れた位置から近づく
本人が気付いて小さく手を振る
目が合って笑うところまで撮る

reference.creator: 佐藤ノア
reference.referencePoint: お祭りで近い距離からカメラに笑いかける場面。友達が撮っているような距離感と顔の高さを参照。
reference.originalAddition: カメラに気付く→小さく手を振る→笑う動きはなおい用に追加。浴衣・祭りは不要。
reference.referencePointEn: A festival moment with a smile toward a nearby camera. Refer to the face height and close distance, like footage taken by a friend.
reference.originalAdditionEn: For Naoi, add noticing the camera, a small wave, then a smile. The reference does not establish the waving action; a yukata or festival setting is not needed.

en.title: Meeting Naoi
en.summary: A friendly greeting as she notices the approaching camera.
steps: Approach from a short distance away
Have her notice the camera and give a small wave
Keep filming through eye contact and a smile

title: 撮影日のミニVlog
summary: 撮影日の流れそのものを短い記録にする。
steps: 到着・服選び・撮影を短く撮る
休憩中の表情や小物も残す
今日のベストカットで終える

reference.creator: 佐藤ノア
reference.referencePoint: 時刻付きで生活の断片をつなぐsetlog。補助リールは高尾山へ行った日の私服・食べ物・遊び心を見せる日常記録。
reference.originalAddition: 到着→服選び→撮影→休憩→ベストカットの撮影日記に置き換え、20〜30秒へ短くする。
reference.referencePointEn: A timestamped setlog connecting small moments from daily life. The secondary reel records a Mount Takao outing through casual clothing, food, and playful moments.
reference.originalAdditionEn: Make a 20–30-second shoot-day diary: arrival, outfit selection, shooting, a break, and the best shot.

en.title: A mini shoot-day vlog
en.summary: Turn the day's actual flow into a short visual diary.
steps: Capture short clips of arrival, outfit selection, and shooting
Keep moments from breaks and close-ups of small items
End with the day's best shot

title: 正面のプロフィール写真
summary: 胸から上。前髪と輪郭が分かる基本の一枚。
steps: 胸から上を入れる
目に光が入る位置へ顔を向ける
正面と微笑みを数枚残す

reference.creator: 佐藤ノア @sugar_79
reference.referencePoint: 1枚目。白い背景と白いトップス、正面に近い胸上ポートレート。顔を主役にした明るさと背景の簡潔さ。
reference.originalAddition: 頭は少し傾いている。服・髪型をそのまま合わせる必要はない。
reference.referencePointEn: Slide 1: a nearly front-facing, chest-up portrait with a white top and white background. Refer to the face-focused brightness and simple background.
reference.originalAdditionEn: The head is slightly tilted in the reference. Use Naoi's own clothing and hairstyle.

en.title: A front-facing profile portrait
en.summary: A chest-up portrait that clearly shows the bangs and face shape.
steps: Frame from the chest up
Turn the face toward light that creates a catchlight
Take several front-facing and softly smiling shots

title: 斜め45度の顔
summary: 肩は斜め、顔はカメラへ。本人が好きな角度を探す。
steps: 肩を斜めに向ける
顔だけカメラへ向ける
左右の角度を撮り比べる

reference.creator: 佐藤ノア @sugar_79
reference.referencePoint: 2〜3枚目。花柄ワンピースの胸上、肩を斜めにしてカメラへ顔を向ける角度。
reference.originalAddition: カルーセルの2〜3枚目を見る。
reference.referencePointEn: Slides 2–3: a chest-up portrait in a floral dress, with the shoulders angled and the face turned toward the camera.
reference.originalAdditionEn: Refer to slides 2–3 of the carousel.

en.title: A 45-degree portrait
en.summary: Angle the shoulders and turn the face toward the camera to find a favorite view.
steps: Turn the shoulders slightly to one side
Turn only the face toward the camera
Compare angles from both sides

title: 真横の横顔
summary: 鼻先から首元のラインと髪を見せる。
steps: 真横から胸上を撮る
髪を下ろす・耳に掛けるの両方
背景をシンプルにする

reference.creator: なえなの @naenano0114
reference.referencePoint: 6枚目。目線を外した横向きの顔と、頬・顎・髪の輪郭。
reference.originalAddition: 参考は真横90度ではなく斜め横顔。撮影時はさらに横を向くアレンジ。
reference.referencePointEn: Slide 6: an off-camera, sideways gaze showing the outlines of the cheek, jaw, and hair.
reference.originalAdditionEn: The reference is a three-quarter side view, not a 90-degree profile. Have Naoi turn farther to the side.
